entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's junk.
I understand you'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse. Can you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's under jsmith123@email.com. And hurry up, I don't have all day.
Thank you. I've located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse 15 days ago. What seems to be the issue with the device?
It doesn't track my heart rate properly, the sleep tracking is completely off, and the battery life is a joke. It's basically a useless smart watch.
I apologize you're experiencing issues with your VeloBand Pulse. Let me check our return policy.
Just tell me if I can return it or not. This whole thing is ridiculous.
Okay, Mr. Smith, according to our records, you are within our standard return policy timeframe. You have 90 days to return your item for a full refund.
Ninety days? Seriously? Finally, some good news. So I can just send it back?

Yes, you can. I'll go ahead and process the return for you. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email within the next hour. Simply package the VeloBand Pulse securely, affix the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location.
Okay, great. Will I get my money back right away?
Once we receive the returned item, your refund will be processed and credited back to your original payment method. It typically takes 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account.
Alright, that sounds good. Thanks for finally getting that sorted out. I was worried I was stuck with this thing.
You're very welcome, Mr. Smith. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again.
You're welcome. Have a great day!
